title: gridsim-model-assignments/1: user models bound to machines of a dynamics study (RC5 WP12)
description: The sidecar of dynamics-study --model-assignments <file>. Each entry binds one governor or exciter model to one machine, by RAW bus and machine id, in place of the controller its DYR record gives. A declarative entry names a shipped model (model) or a gridsim-model/1 document (file, relative to this file, pinned by sha256). A plug-in entry names a model of the --model-plugins configuration; without that flag it is refused. Every object forbids unknown members; a duplicate member is refused by the parser.

model.description: A shipped model id (gridsim user-model list).

file.description: A gridsim-model/1 document, relative to this file.

sha256.description: Required with file: the SHA-256 of its exact bytes.

deviceModels.description: Injection, machine and load models with no DYR record of their own (RC5 WP32), and user relays (RC5 wp32b). An injection or machine model binds to a unit (bind.machine), a load model to a bus (bind.bus, bind.pMw, bind.qMvar), a relay to a unit (bind.machine) or to a branch (bind.branch, read at its from end as written). The role must be the model's own. A machine model is a contract 2 plug-in; a relay is a contract 2 plug-in or a gridsim-model/1 document of role relay.

file.description: A gridsim-model/1 document, relative to this file.

sha256.description: Required with file: the SHA-256 of its exact bytes.
